title: Grêmio opens ticket sales for Copa do Brasil semifinal
seoTitle: Grêmio opens ticket sales for Copa do Brasil semifinal
subtitle: Learn how to secure your spot in the Copa do Brasil final
excerpt: Grêmio starts ticket sales for the semifinal against Atlético-MG, detailing dates, prices, and purchase rules for members and the general public.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: GZH, Clube Atlético Mineiro, Rádio Itatiaia
contentHtml:
The Tricolor began selling tickets for the first leg of the Copa do Brasil semifinal against Atlético-MG. The opening of sales is generating significant movement among fans looking to secure their spot in the decisive match.

How sales work for the first leg

Tickets for the match, which will be played on November 1st at the Arena, go on sale at 2 PM this Friday (9) exclusively for Grêmio members. Non-members will have access to purchase tickets starting Tuesday (13) at 11 AM.

Ticket price range

Prices range from R$ 20 to R$ 360, depending on the sector's location in the Arena. This variety allows fans of different profiles to find options compatible with their budget.

Ticket sales for the second leg

Atlético-MG announced that tickets for the return leg, scheduled for Saturday, November 7th, at 6 PM, at Arena MRV, will be available starting Monday (5) with an initial price of R$ 29.90 for GNV members in the Inter Norte sector. There will be no additional tickets, and purchases will be limited to one ticket per GNV plan.

Purchase and pickup procedures

GNV Premium members can redeem their tickets up to 15 minutes into the first half; GNV Black members have a guarantee up to 24 hours before the match. Purchase cancellation is available until 6 PM on Friday (6) prior to the game. Access to Arena MRV will require facial biometrics for those over 12 years old, and e-tickets will only be accepted via the Galo Super App.

Financial impact of the semifinal

With their qualification for the semifinal, Grêmio has already earned R$ 18 million in the competition. A spot in the final would guarantee at least R$ 34 million in case of a runner-up finish, while the title would secure R$ 78 million and a direct spot in the Libertadores group stage.

With information from GZH, Clube Atlético Mineiro, Rádio Itatiaia.
